sources.concept: Credential-changing syscall sequence with prepared supplementary-group state

impact.attacker_capability: Cause the documented assertion panic when able to establish the reproducer's required credential/group state and invoke the relevant credential-changing syscall path.

causal_trace.summary: The supplied issue-specific syzkaller program establishes the input/state sequence used for the reported crash.

Before the fix, crcopysafe() used the old credential's allocated group-slot count (cr_agroups) as the requested extension count rather than its logical supplementary-group count (cr_ngroups). Allocator power-of-two or page rounding can make allocated slots exceed ngroups_max.
crcopysafe() passes the allocation-sized request to crextend(), whose requested-count check trips when that rounded capacity exceeds ngroups_max.
The recorded execution panics on the “too many supplementary groups” assertion; the backtrace includes crextend(), crcopysafe(), and sys_setregid().

failure.operation: crextend() bound assertion for supplementary-group count

primary_invariant.kind: logical supplementary-group count versus allocation capacity
primary_invariant.statement: Credential-copy extension requests must be based on the old credential's logical group count, while allocation capacity remains internal storage metadata.
primary_invariant.violated_because: crcopysafe() treated rounded allocated capacity (cr_agroups) as a requested group count; that capacity can exceed ngroups_max although the logical count does not.

quality.review_notes: Maintainer patch directly describes the capacity-versus-logical-count confusion, and the issue supplies a syzkaller reproducer plus crash evidence. The artifacts do not establish which privileges or environmental setup an untrusted local caller needs to establish the prerequisite group state; the reproducer declares sandbox:none. No post-fix execution result is supplied, and evidence supports availability loss only, not memory corruption or privilege escalation.

remediation.invariant_restored: crcopysafe() extends storage only until it can hold oldcred->cr_ngroups and calls crextend() with that logical count rather than oldcred->cr_agroups.
mitigation_classes: separate logical length from allocation capacity
bound extension requests by logical supplementary-group count

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The supplied syzkaller program is the available setup evidence; required caller privileges and environmental preconditions are not established by this bundle.
data_structure_invariants: cr_ngroups is the logical number of supplementary groups.
cr_agroups is allocated group-slot capacity and can exceed the logical count because of allocator rounding.
The count passed to crextend() must remain below ngroups_max.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The relevant logical count must remain valid while rounded allocation capacity can exceed ngroups_max.
numeric_domains.name: supplementary group count

state_context.state_machine: A credential with supplementary-group allocation capacity is copied during a credential-changing syscall; the failure occurs when capacity metadata is forwarded as a requested logical group count.
